name: EXM_CARD_HOLDER_DETAILS
description: This table contains the details of the corporate card holders, such as name and employee number.

columns.name: FULL_NAME
columns.description: Full name of the corporate card holder as provided by the corporate card issuer in the charge file.

columns.name: FIRST_NAME
columns.description: First name of the corporate card holder as provided by the corporate card issuer in the charge file.

columns.name: MIDDLE_NAME
columns.description: Middle name of the corporate card holder as provided by the corporate card issuer in the charge file.

columns.name: LAST_NAME
columns.description: Last name of the corporate card holder as provided by the corporate card issuer in the charge file.

columns.name: WORKER_NUMBER
columns.description: Employee number of the corporate card holder as provided by the corporate card issuer in the charge file.

columns.name: NATIONAL_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: National identifier number of the corporate card holder, such as social security number, as provided by the corporate card issuer in the charge file. Value is encrypted.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CARD_HOLDER_IDENTIFICATION
columns.description: Corporate card holder identification such as employee number or national identifier.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
